issues: 骨架件是 1px 灰描边的空框，无材质无阴影，暗底上几乎看不见层次
480×270 设计坐标里的字只有 6–7px（放大后 24–28px），大半文字小到只能当纹理
内容是“The headline for your product here / Acme Studio”这类占位模板，成形后的页面没有设计感
两段之间没有停顿，骨架刚到文字就压上来，读不出“这是第二步”
changes: 换 graphite 石墨暗场 + 胶片金唯一强调色，成形画面是虚构调色软件「Obscura 3」的发布页：玻璃导航、112px 衬线大标题「Grade every frame / like it was film.」、金色 CTA、三枚指标块、640×760 调色台卡
骨架段 10 件从画外 120–420px 平面飞入（overshoot 过冲 + ±7° 旋转回正 + 按速度的方向性模糊），开场即有 12 栏版式参考线
两段之间留 8f 停顿、参考线同步退淡；文字段逐字 perspective(900px) 3D 翻滚落位（dz −200→−760、三轴大角度旋转、远虚近实），先大标题后 mono 小标注
全部按 1920 原生坐标排版，要读的字 ≥28–36px、标题 112px，告别 DesignStage 的小字
落定后加一笔“定稿”：CTA 通电成金色实底，胶片画面被金色竖线从 log 灰片擦除成暖调成片，色轮控制点同步推到偏色位——呼应标题
时长 156→168f，f128 前所有字落完，留 40f 整页 hold + 1.5% 极缓推近
issuesEn: Skeleton parts are empty 1px grey outlines with no material or shadow, nearly invisible on the dark ground
In the 480x270 design space text was 6–7px (24–28px once scaled), so most of it could only read as texture
Content was a placeholder template ('The headline for your product here' / 'Acme Studio'), so the assembled page had no design
No pause between phases: text piled on as soon as the skeleton landed, so 'this is step two' never read
changesEn: Graphite dark stage with film gold as the only accent; the result is a launch page for a fictional grading app 'Obscura 3': glass nav, 112px serif headline 'Grade every frame / like it was film.', gold CTA, three stat tiles and a 640x760 grading-panel card
Ten skeleton parts fly in planar from 120–420px off-frame (overshoot settle, ±7° rotation, velocity-driven directional blur); a 12-column layout grid is on screen from frame one

An 8f pause separates the phases while the guides fade; text then tumbles in per character in perspective(900px) 3D (dz −200 to −760, large three-axis rotation, depth blur), headline first and mono labels last
Laid out natively at 1920 with readable text at 28–36px and a 112px headline, dropping the tiny DesignStage type

A finishing beat after landing: the CTA powers on to solid gold and a gold wipe grades the film still from flat log to a warm print look while the color-wheel pucks move off neutral, echoing the headline
Duration 156 to 168f: every glyph lands by f128, leaving a 40f hold with a 1.5% slow push
